moments.title: They will not commit to something intense — and a refresher is coming
moments.summary: On why a long intense course is the wrong shape for some audiences: they do not want more commitment or anything so intense, so it has to be delivered one way rather than demanding much back. The facilitator answers that she is definitely doing one refresher, maybe a few months down the line.
moments.evidence: They don't want more commitment, they don't want something so intense or something Exactly, so I'm doing it for them and what I was saying is I'm definitely doing one refresher Maybe like a few months down the line
